top_choice_rationale: P001 (Anne Carson alone) rests on the writing, not on the shared first-place ranking. The voice is recognisable in a few lines. Autobiography of Red and Nox show form carrying meaning, as a verse novel and as an elegy in which translation, commentary and archival fragments are part of the grief. Loss, desire, inheritance and the limits of translation recur across verse, essay and drama, which reads as one coherent project. The citation should credit her own original lyric, verse narrative and essay, with translation counted only where it is method inside original work such as Nox, and should name the exposed feeling so it does not read as a prize for erudition. Uncertainties remain: whether the later decade deepens the project or refines a settled method, how much page-dependent effect survives translation into Swedish, and where scholarship ends and literature begins. These come from public knowledge only and I have not independently verified any text. I would prefer the award to no award, because the case for Carson is better established on the evidence we hold than the case for withholding the prize.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile. Her own work in literary non-fiction, including biographies of Raoul Wallenberg and Alfred Nobel, is context only. As Permanent Secretary she is expected to announce the laureate, which is a procedural role. Her committee voting status is undocumented, so her simulated vote is a modeling assumption.
